title: TSTM Execution Result Record
description: One row per (sequence, implementation), produced ONLY after real execution against a real client. Never hand-authored or inferred. Per Agent 4 Section 17 / Section 27 (no empirical claims without actual execution).

implementation.description: go-tuf-v2 only, per Agent 3/4: legacy go-tuf (v0.7.0) excluded to avoid spec-version confound. tuf-js added as a third independent implementation (Future Research item (3), now executed).

implementation_version.description: Exact pinned commit hash or release tag. Never a floating branch name like 'main'.

spec_version.description: TUF specification version the implementation claims to target, as declared by the implementation itself.

execution_status.description: Distinguishes a genuine semantic REJECT from a harness/execution failure (Agent 4 Section 21 concern: a crash is NOT a correct REJECT).

observed_decision_trace.description: One decision per transition step actually observed from the client. Empty if execution_status != COMPLETED.

observed_final_state.description: Trusted state as read via the ClientRunner introspection interface after the sequence. Fields marked NOT_OBSERVABLE in Agent 4 Section 4 must be reported as null, never guessed.

oracle_match.description: True/false only if execution_status == COMPLETED and the property's oracle_type is DIRECT or COMPOSED_UNAMBIGUOUS. Null if not evaluable (e.g. harness error, unsupported feature).

conformance_class.description: Assigned by the strict adjudication hierarchy in agent5_pipeline.py -- never by majority vote between implementations (Agent 3 Section 16 / Agent 4 Section 18).

failure_stage.description: step_index at which a violation or failure was first observed, if any.

raw_log_reference.description: Path/URI to the unmodified raw execution log for this run. Mandatory for reproducibility (Agent 4 Section 25).
